Nina CS: quick sync for SilverAnchor private/VPC onboarding. Scope: network egress to Datadog, IAM role for cross-account logging, KMS key access, and audit log visibility. Renewal rep asked to confirm audit stream this week. What are blockers?
Pat (SilverAnchor): logs not reaching Datadog; our ops sees TLS failures. Also need exact role ARN to add to our sidecar trust policy.
Carl (Network): seeing RSTs from the forwarder subnet. Pat, can you confirm Datadog collector IPs and whether they expect mTLS?
Pat (SilverAnchor): collectors: dd-1.prod.datadog.internal (52.12.101.23) and dd-2.prod.datadog.internal (52.12.101.24). Yes they require mTLS; thumbprint will be DM'd.
Carl (Network): will open egress to those two IPs and enable outbound-only to tcp/443. ETA 15m. Command: "aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0fa12b --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 52.12.101.23/32" then add second IP.
Mei (SolutionsEng): IAM: use role arn: arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/silveranchor-log-writer. We need sts:AssumeRole from their sidecar principal.
Raj (Security): KMS policy note: allow decrypt/generate-data-key for that role but scope by encryption context. Snippet: {"Sid":"AllowSilverAnchorLogging","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/silveranchor-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:source":"silveranchor-audit"}}} Apply to the CMK.
Mei (SolutionsEng): propose key rotation window Sat 03:00 UTC (low traffic). Pat, ok?
Pat (SilverAnchor): Sat 03:00 UTC works. We'll pause ingestion for 10m and verify.
Nina CS: action items: 1) Carl open egress to Datadog IPs (ETA 15m). 2) Raj to drop final KMS JSON (ETA 1h). 3) Mei schedule rotation Sat 03:00 UTC and send invite. 4) Pat to paste a sample post-rotation log. Note: renewal check Fri; we need audit delivery + rotation validated by EOD Thu to avoid escalation.
log-bot: forwarder-job #789 started -> status: running.
Carl (Network): egress rules applied, verified TCP 443 to both collectors from a test instance.
log-bot: forwarder-job #789 finished -> status: success, 0 errors.
Pat (SilverAnchor): re-tested after egress changes and now seeing 200s. sample: \"{\"ts\":\"2026-03-20T11:22:33Z\",\"status\":200,\"msg\":\"event accepted\"}\"
Mei (SolutionsEng): after KMS change we'll watch CloudTrail for KMS:AccessDenied spikes and lambda 403s. Please capture 5-min tails pre/post.
Nina CS: good momentum. Marking thread in-flight. I will send a short health snapshot before the renewal touchpoint. If anything slips, escalate to CS lead immediately.
